people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.
translations.bsb: and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Jehovah to gaze, and many of them perish.
